options.content:
Thruster load test

The items to be monitored of the thruster load test of 13 Oct 2026, per test step. Only the FWD pod was run that day; the **Pod** selector switches the propulsion, drive, cooling and hydraulics panels between FWD and AFT. Batteries and DC switches serve both pods. **Times are UTC.** The test log was kept in local time (UTC+2); the annotations are the logged steps converted to UTC, labelled with the step, the planned rpm and the load as logged. The AMCS trend screenshots are in UTC. **DC power** = raw × 0.1 kW, positive when consuming. **Shaft power** and **propeller speed** come from the PLC, raw / 10, in kW (negative when propelling) and rpm (without sign). **Torque** = raw × 100 Nm at the motor shaft. **Pitch and azimuth** in whole degrees. **THRS** temperatures in °C and flows in l/min. **DC switch** board temperature raw × 0.1 °C. The info icon of each panel states its source, scaling and corrections.

panels.title: Logged steps against the data
panels.description: One row per logged step, in UTC. Logged: the load and pitch override setting as written in the test log. The pitch override is presumably a pitch ratio P/D, not an angle; it is converted to degrees with the PLC's own conversion, angle = atan(P/D / 2.2), to compare with the measured pitch. Measured: the average over the step of the PLC's propeller speed (raw / 10 rpm) and shaft power (raw / 10 kW, negative when propelling), the pitch and the azimuth range (whole degrees), and the DC power of drive 1 and 2 (raw × 0.1 kW, positive when consuming). Only FWD was run on 13 Oct 2026.

targets.rawSql:
WITH steps AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, '25 % rpm', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 09:12:00', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 09:20:00', -5, 0.9),
    (2, '50 % rpm', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 09:21:00', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 09:31:00', -35, 0.9),
    (3, '75 % rpm', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 09:32:00', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 09:55:00', -105, 0.65),
    (4, '100 % rpm', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 09:56:00', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 10:05:00', -160, 0.65),
    (5, 'cool down', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 10:06:00', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 12:28:00', 0, NULL),
    (11, '25 % rpm', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 12:28:00', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 13:01:00', -5, 0.9),
    (12, '50 % rpm', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 13:16:00', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 13:59:00', -50, 0.9),
    (13, '75 % rpm', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 13:59:00', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 14:30:00', -77, 0.7),
    (14, '100 % rpm', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 14:31:00', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 15:01:00', -140, 0.6),
    (15, 'cool down', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 15:01:00', TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 15:53:00', 0, NULL)) v (step, label, start_time, stop_time, load_kw, pitch_override)),
pcs AS (SELECT s.step, avg(p.azimuth_prop_speed__value) / 10.0 AS rpm, avg(p.azimuth_prop_mech_power__value) / 10.0 AS shaft,
    avg(p.propellor_pitch__value) AS pitch, min(p.propellor_azimuth__value) AS az_min, max(p.propellor_azimuth__value) AS az_max
  FROM steps s JOIN (SELECT * FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod} WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) p ON p.timestamp >= s.start_time AND p.timestamp < s.stop_time
  GROUP BY s.step),
dc AS (SELECT s.step, avg(CASE WHEN d.drive = 1 THEN d.power END) * 0.1 AS d1, avg(CASE WHEN d.drive = 2 THEN d.power END) * 0.1 AS d2
  FROM steps s JOIN (SELECT timestamp, 1 AS drive, power__value AS power FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}_ara1 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT timestamp, 2 AS drive, power__value AS power FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}_ara2 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) d
    ON d.timestamp >= s.start_time AND d.timestamp < s.stop_time
  GROUP BY s.step)
SELECT s.step AS "Step", s.label AS "Planned", s.start_time AS "Start", s.stop_time AS "Stop",
  s.load_kw AS "Load, logged [kW]", round(pcs.shaft, 1) AS "Shaft power [kW]",
  round(dc.d1, 1) AS "DC drive 1 [kW]", round(dc.d2, 1) AS "DC drive 2 [kW]", round(pcs.rpm, 1) AS "Propeller speed [rpm]",
  s.pitch_override AS "Pitch override, logged [P/D]",
  round(degrees(atan(s.pitch_override / 2.2)), 1) AS "Pitch override [deg]", round(pcs.pitch, 1) AS "Pitch [deg]",
  pcs.az_min AS "Azimuth min [deg]", pcs.az_max AS "Azimuth max [deg]"
FROM steps s LEFT JOIN pcs ON pcs.step = s.step LEFT JOIN dc ON dc.step = s.step
ORDER BY s.start_time

panels.title: Propeller speed and shaft power
panels.description: Propeller speed from the PLC, raw / 10 rpm, without sign. Shaft power: the propeller's mechanical power from the PLC, raw / 10 kW, with the sign as the PLC sends it: negative when propelling. The load column of the test log fits this value.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(azimuth_prop_speed__value) / 10.0 AS "Propeller speed",
  avg(azimuth_prop_mech_power__value) / 10.0 AS "Shaft power"
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pitch and azimuth
panels.description: Propeller pitch and azimuth from the PLC, in whole degrees. The pitch is shown as an angle, not as the pitch ratio P/D = 2.2 × tan(pitch): the whole-degree resolution makes P/D move in steps of about 0.04 at 15° to 0.05 at 30°, coarser than the differences between the pitch override settings in the test log (0.6, 0.65, 0.7, 0.9), and the feathered position (about 87°) converts to a P/D of about 42. The test log's pitch override setting is presumably a P/D; the setting itself is not published, and the step table shows it converted to degrees.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(propellor_pitch__value) AS "Pitch",
  avg(propellor_azimuth__value) AS "Azimuth"
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Power and PMS limits
panels.description: Solid: DC power per drive, raw × 0.1 kW, positive when consuming. Dashed: the power limits the PMS gives each drive, in kW as the PMS sends them, positive; the propulsion limit is drawn above zero, the regeneration limit negated below zero. The limits are the lowest value in each interval, so short drops show. In Sailing the PLC limits the drives to ±1 kW, and in hydrogeneration with the lever at or behind zero the propulsion limit is 0. Astern, the PLC applies the regeneration limit to propulsion and the other way round. Until 15 Oct 2026 the PMS's consumed power was published in 0.1 kW and the propulsion limit followed the larger of 110 and that consumed power, so on 13 Oct the limits did not bind; since 15 Oct the consumed power is in kW.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN drive = 1 THEN power END) * 0.1 AS "DC drive 1",
  avg(CASE WHEN drive = 2 THEN power END) * 0.1 AS "DC drive 2"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, 1 AS drive, power__value AS power FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}_ara1 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, 2 AS drive, power__value AS power FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}_ara2 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) a
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  min(CASE WHEN right(topic, 4) = 'u101' THEN setpoint_power__value END) AS "Propulsion limit d1",
  min(CASE WHEN right(topic, 4) = 'u102' THEN setpoint_power__value END) AS "Propulsion limit d2",
  -min(CASE WHEN right(topic, 4) = 'u101' THEN produce_power_limit__value END) AS "Regeneration limit d1",
  -min(CASE WHEN right(topic, 4) = 'u102' THEN produce_power_limit__value END) AS "Regeneration limit d2"
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion_ara
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND topic IN ('marpower/150000-propulsion-ara/' || CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '13-31-u101' ELSE '13-11-u101' END, 'marpower/150000-propulsion-ara/' || CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '13-31-u102' ELSE '13-11-u102' END)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Torque per drive and PLC limits
panels.description: Solid: the torque each Aradex drive's winding set puts on the motor shaft (before the 1.478 gearbox), published as whole % of 10 000 Nm, so raw × 100 Nm in steps of 100 Nm. Dashed: the maximum and minimum torque the PLC sends each drive (setpoints 2 and 3, in Nm as sent, the most restrictive value in each interval), derived from the PMS power limits and clamped by the PLC at ±1163 Nm per drive on FWD and ±3226 Nm on AFT. In torque mode the drive reads setpoints 2 and 3 as speed limits, so there they mean nothing on this axis.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN drive = 1 THEN torque END) * 100 AS "Drive 1",
  avg(CASE WHEN drive = 2 THEN torque END) * 100 AS "Drive 2",
  min(CASE WHEN drive = 1 THEN max_torque END) AS "Max torque sent d1",
  min(CASE WHEN drive = 2 THEN max_torque END) AS "Max torque sent d2",
  max(CASE WHEN drive = 1 THEN min_torque END) AS "Min torque sent d1",
  max(CASE WHEN drive = 2 THEN min_torque END) AS "Min torque sent d2"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, 1 AS drive, torque__value AS torque, setpoint_2__value AS max_torque, setpoint_3__value AS min_torque FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}_ara1 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, 2 AS drive, torque__value AS torque, setpoint_2__value AS max_torque, setpoint_3__value AS min_torque FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}_ara2 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) a
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Ramp check
panels.description: Rate of change of the propeller speed from the PLC (raw / 10 rpm, without sign) between consecutive samples: positive = speeding up, negative = slowing down. Red: specified, zero to max in no less than 6 s: FWD 500 rpm = ±83.3 rpm/s, AFT 400 rpm = ±66.7 rpm/s. Blue: the drive ramps, 3 Hz/s both ways since 8 Oct 2026 = ±121.8 rpm/s. Samples are about 3 s apart and skip unchanged values, so this underestimates peaks: a value beyond a line is real, one inside is not proof.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, (rpm - prev_rpm) / ((CAST(time AS BIGINT) - CAST(prev_time AS BIGINT)) / 1e9) AS "Propeller speed rate"
FROM (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, azimuth_prop_speed__value / 10.0 AS rpm,
    LAG(azimuth_prop_speed__value / 10.0) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_rpm,
    LAG(timestamp) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_time
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
) t
WHERE prev_time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(azimuth_prop_speed__value) / 10.0 AS "Propeller speed",
  CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN 83.3 ELSE 66.7 END AS "Specified limit",
  -CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN 83.3 ELSE 66.7 END AS "Specified limit −",
  121.8 AS "Drive ramp (±121.8 rpm/s)",
  -121.8 AS "Drive ramp −"
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Winding temperatures
panels.description: The six stator winding temperatures, U, V, W of winding sets 1 and 2, in °C as published by the PMS. The W1 column is named differently on FWD and AFT; the hidden variable picks the right one.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(windingtempu_1__value) AS "U1",
  avg(windingtempv_1__value) AS "V1",
  avg(${winding_w1}__value) AS "W1",
  avg(windingtempu_2__value) AS "U2",
  avg(windingtempv_2__value) AS "V2",
  avg(windingtempw_2__value) AS "W2"
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Bearing temperatures
panels.description: Motor bearing temperatures, drive end and non-drive end, in °C. The test plan asks for upper and lower; presumably the drive end is the upper bearing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(bearing_de_temp__value) AS "Drive end",
  avg(bearing_nde_temp__value) AS "Non-drive end"
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: IGBT temperature
panels.description: IGBT temperature of each Aradex drive, in °C. The drives publish 199 while off; those values are left out. Drive 2 matches U102 in the Aradex extract, so drive 1 is presumably U101.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN drive = 1 THEN NULLIF(igbt, 199) END) AS "Drive 1",
  avg(CASE WHEN drive = 2 THEN NULLIF(igbt, 199) END) AS "Drive 2"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, 1 AS drive, temp_igbt__value AS igbt FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}_ara1 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, 2 AS drive, temp_igbt__value AS igbt FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}_ara2 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) a
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Power stage temperature
panels.description: Power stage temperature of each Aradex drive, in °C; presumably the coldplate of the test plan. The drives publish 199 while off; those values are left out.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN drive = 1 THEN NULLIF(stage, 199) END) AS "Drive 1",
  avg(CASE WHEN drive = 2 THEN NULLIF(stage, 199) END) AS "Drive 2"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, 1 AS drive, temp_power_stage__value AS stage FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}_ara1 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp, 2 AS drive, temp_power_stage__value AS stage FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}_ara2 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) a
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Thruster
panels.description: The pod's thruster cooling circuit: the common supply temperature, the pod's return temperature and flow. THRS sensors, temperatures in °C, flows in l/min (right axis).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = '50001038-28' THEN temperature__value END) AS "In",
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '50001038-02' ELSE '50001038-01' END THEN temperature__value END) AS "Out"
FROM public.marpower__thrs__temperatures
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND yard_tag IN ('50001038-28', CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '50001038-02' ELSE '50001038-01' END)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '50001057-22' ELSE '50001218-02' END THEN flow__value END) AS "Flow"
FROM public.marpower__thrs__flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND yard_tag IN (CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '50001057-22' ELSE '50001218-02' END)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Drive 1 (U101)
panels.description: Cooling of Aradex drive 1: the pod's drive supply temperature, the drive's return temperature and flow. THRS sensors, temperatures in °C, flows in l/min (right axis).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '50001038-62' ELSE '50001038-63' END THEN temperature__value END) AS "In",
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '50001038-61' ELSE '50001038-32' END THEN temperature__value END) AS "Out"
FROM public.marpower__thrs__temperatures
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND yard_tag IN (CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '50001038-62' ELSE '50001038-63' END, CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '50001038-61' ELSE '50001038-32' END)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '50001057-15' ELSE '50001057-13' END THEN flow__value END) AS "Flow"
FROM public.marpower__thrs__flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND yard_tag IN (CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '50001057-15' ELSE '50001057-13' END)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Drive 2 (U102)
panels.description: Cooling of Aradex drive 2: the pod's drive supply temperature, the drive's return temperature and flow. THRS sensors, temperatures in °C, flows in l/min (right axis).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '50001038-62' ELSE '50001038-63' END THEN temperature__value END) AS "In",
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '50001038-72' ELSE '50001038-64' END THEN temperature__value END) AS "Out"
FROM public.marpower__thrs__temperatures
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND yard_tag IN (CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '50001038-62' ELSE '50001038-63' END, CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '50001038-72' ELSE '50001038-64' END)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '50001057-14' ELSE '50001057-16' END THEN flow__value END) AS "Flow"
FROM public.marpower__thrs__flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND yard_tag IN (CASE '${pod}' WHEN 'fwd' THEN '50001057-14' ELSE '50001057-16' END)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Brightloops FWD 1–2
panels.description: The battery DC/DC converters' cooling loops on the FWD side: supply temperature, return temperature and flow per loop. The test plan monitored all six loops during the FWD runs, so both sides are shown for either pod. THRS sensors, temperatures in °C, flows in l/min (right axis).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = '50001038-69' THEN temperature__value END) AS "In",
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = '50001038-13' THEN temperature__value END) AS "Out 1",
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = '50001038-12' THEN temperature__value END) AS "Out 2"
FROM public.marpower__thrs__temperatures
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND yard_tag IN ('50001038-69', '50001038-13', '50001038-12')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = '50001057-12' THEN flow__value END) AS "Flow 1",
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = '50001057-11' THEN flow__value END) AS "Flow 2"
FROM public.marpower__thrs__flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND yard_tag IN ('50001057-12', '50001057-11')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Brightloops AFT 1–4
panels.description: The battery DC/DC converters' cooling loops on the AFT side: supply temperature, return temperature and flow per loop. The test plan monitored all six loops during the FWD runs, so both sides are shown for either pod. THRS sensors, temperatures in °C, flows in l/min (right axis).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = '50001038-15' THEN temperature__value END) AS "In",
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = '50001038-08' THEN temperature__value END) AS "Out 1",
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = '50001038-07' THEN temperature__value END) AS "Out 2",
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = '50001038-06' THEN temperature__value END) AS "Out 3",
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = '50001038-05' THEN temperature__value END) AS "Out 4"
FROM public.marpower__thrs__temperatures
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND yard_tag IN ('50001038-15', '50001038-08', '50001038-07', '50001038-06', '50001038-05')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = '50001057-07' THEN flow__value END) AS "Flow 1",
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = '50001057-06' THEN flow__value END) AS "Flow 2",
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = '50001057-05' THEN flow__value END) AS "Flow 3",
  avg(CASE WHEN yard_tag = '50001057-04' THEN flow__value END) AS "Flow 4"
FROM public.marpower__thrs__flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND yard_tag IN ('50001057-07', '50001057-06', '50001057-05', '50001057-04')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Hydraulic oil temperature
panels.description: Hydraulic power pack tank temperature from the PLC, in °C as published.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(hydr_tank_temp__value) AS "Oil temperature"
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Shear beams
panels.description: The four shear beams, the load cells in the pod's mounts, raw, in N. Dashed: the calculated shear beam value. It should be torque in Nm, but reads as a force in N: on AFT about −0.43 N per Nm propeller torque, on FWD about 1.25× that.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(shear_beam_1__value) AS "Beam 1",
  avg(shear_beam_2__value) AS "Beam 2",
  avg(shear_beam_3__value) AS "Beam 3",
  avg(shear_beam_4__value) AS "Beam 4",
  avg(shear_beam_calculated__value) AS "Calculated"
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_${pod}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: SoC per pack
panels.description: Minimum state of charge of the pack's strings, in %; the test log matches the minimum. Zero is left out. One series per pack (05_41_1 … 05_46_4), from the pack's BMS. On 13 Oct 2026 packs 05_42 and 05_45 published zeros, and 05_41, 05_43_1 and 05_43_2 temperatures but no SoC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/450000-main-power-storage-errors/5-41-1' THEN NULLIF(minimum_soc__value, 0) END) AS "05_41_1",
  avg(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/450000-main-power-storage-errors/5-41-2' THEN NULLIF(minimum_soc__value, 0) END) AS "05_41_2",
  avg(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/450000-main-power-storage-errors/5-41-3' THEN NULLIF(minimum_soc__value, 0) END) AS "05_41_3",
  avg(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/450000-main-power-storage-errors/5-41-4' THEN NULLIF(minimum_soc__value, 0) END) AS "05_41_4",
  avg(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/450000-main-power-storage-errors/5-42-1' THEN NULLIF(minimum_soc__value, 0) END) AS "05_42_1",
  avg(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/450000-main-power-storage-errors/5-42-2' THEN NULLIF(minimum_soc__value, 0) END) AS "05_42_2",
  avg(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/450000-main-power-storage-errors/5-42-3' THEN NULLIF(minimum_soc__value, 0) END) AS "05_42_3",
  avg(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/450000-main-power-storage-errors/5-43-1' THEN NULLIF(minimum_soc__value, 0) END) AS "05_43_1",
  avg(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/450000-main-power-storage-errors/5-43-2' THEN NULLIF(minimum_soc__value, 0) END) AS "05_43_2",
  avg(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/450000-main-power-storage-errors/5-43-3' THEN NULLIF(minimum_soc__value, 0) END) AS "05_43_3",
  avg(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/450000-main-power-storage-errors/5-44-1' THEN NULLIF(minimum_soc__value, 0) END) AS "05_44_1",
  avg(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/450000-main-power-storage-errors/5-44-2' THEN NULLIF(minimum_soc__value, 0) END) AS "05_44_2",
  avg(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/450000-main-power-storage-errors/5-44-3' THEN NULLIF(minimum_soc__value, 0) END) AS "05_44_3",
